events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at New England Patriots

headlines.description: There were big plays all over the field. The Chiefs, not the Patriots, were making them.
headlines.shortLinkText: Super letdown: Patriots routed in 2nd half, Chiefs win 42-27

events.name: New York Jets at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: Tyrod Taylor threw two touchdown passes and the new-look Bills beat the New York Jets 21-12 on Sunday in Sean McDermott's debut as Buffalo's coach.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bills open McDermott's coaching era with 21-12 win over Jets

headlines.description: Matt Ryan threw an 88-yard touchdown to Austin Hooper and led two fourth-quarter scoring drives, and the NFC champion Atlanta Falcons held on to beat the Chicago Bears 23-17 in the season opener on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan leads 2 TD drives in 4th, Falcons beat Bears 23-17

headlines.description: Baltimore's rebuilt defense picked off Andy Dalton four times and forced him to fumble Sunday, making it easy for Joe Flacco in his return from a back injury as the Ravens pulled away to a 20-0 victory over the Cincinnati Bengals.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens force 5 Dalton turnovers, beat Bengals 20-0

headlines.description: Ben Roethlisberger threw two touchdown passes to tight end Jesse James as the Pittsburgh Steelers, with minimal help from Le'Veon Bell, opened the season by holding off the Cleveland Browns 21-18 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Big Ben leads Steelers to 21-18 win over Browns in opener

headlines.description: Matthew Stafford threw two of his four touchdown passes to rookie Kenny Golladay in the fourth quarter Sunday, helping the Detroit Lions rally to beat the Arizona Cardinals 35-23.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stafford's 4 TD lift Lions to 35-23 win over Cardinals

headlines.description: Derek Carr threw for 262 yards and two touchdowns, and the Oakland Raiders beat the Tennessee Titans 26-13 in a season opener pitting two of the NFL's rising, young quarterbacks.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carr, Raiders edge out Titans yet again 26-13

headlines.description: Carson Wentz threw for 307 yards and two touchdowns as the second-year quarterback guided the Philadelphia Eagles to a 30-17 victory over the Washington Redskins on Sunday in a sloppy, mistake-filled season opener between the NFC East rivals.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wentz, pass rush give Eagles season-opening win vs. Redskins

headlines.description: Leonard Fournette ran for 100 yards and a touchdown in his NFL debut, and Jacksonville had 10 sacks and forced four turnovers to help the Jaguars to a 29-7 win over the Houston Texans on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fournette, strong defense lead Jaguars over Texans 29-7

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: Jared Goff passed for a career-high 306 yards and a touchdown in his first victory as an NFL starter, and the Los Angeles Rams routed the Indianapolis Colts 46-9 Sunday in Sean McVay's impressive debut as the youngest head coach in modern league history.
headlines.shortLinkText: Goff's Rams blast Colts 46-9 in coach McVay's big debut

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Green Bay defensive lineman Mike Daniels' strip sack of Russell Wilson deep in Seattle territory in the third quarter set up Ty Montgomery's 6-yard touchdown run on the next play to spark the Packers' 17-9 win on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Packers beat Seahawks 17-9 to take NFC heavyweight match

headlines.description: Cam Newton threw a pair of touchdown passes following San Francisco turnovers and the Carolina defense shut down Kyle Shanahan's offense in his coaching debut as the Panthers beat the 49ers 23-3 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Newton throws 2 TDs to lead Panthers past 49ers 23-3

events.name: New York Giants at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: Jason Witten scored the only touchdown while breaking the franchise record for yards receiving and the Dallas defense shackled a New York offense missing Odell Beckham Jr. in the Cowboys' 19-3 season-opening victory over the Giants on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Record-setting Witten, Cowboys top Giants 19-3 in opener

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Miami Dolphins

notes.headline: DUE TO HURRICANE IRMA, THIS GAME IS MOVING TO WEEK 11.

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Minnesota Vikings

headlines.description: Sam Bradford started his second season with Minnesota in style, passing for 346 yards and three touchdowns to help the Vikings beat New Orleans 29-19 on Monday night and spoil Adrian Peterson's first game with the Saints.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bradford, Vikings cruise past Saints 29-19 in opener

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: Shelby Harris got a hand on Younghoe Koo's 44-yard field goal attempt with a second left, and the Broncos began the Vance Joseph era with a 24-21 win over the Los Angeles Chargers on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Broncos block late FG, top Chargers 24-21 in Joseph's debut
